Subject: Response to Request for Information for Harmony Games GAMES INC - Workers’ Compensation Account Setup
Dear [Washington State workers’ Compensation Team/Specific Contact’s Name, if known],
Thank you for reaching out. Please find below the requested information regarding Harmony Games Inc. to facilitate the setup of our workers’ compensation account.
1. *Business Operations*:
2.  Harmony Games Inc. is a mobile game development company focused on creating engaging and interactive digital entertainment experiences. Our primary operations involve the design, development, testing, and maintenance of mobile gaming applications for a global audience.
3. *Employee Job Duties and Activities in Washington*:
    ◦ *Job Roles*: Our team consists of software developers, designers, QA testers, administrative staff, and one Washington-based employee in a senior business development role.
• *Duties*:
        ▪︎ *Vice President of Marketing and Business Development (Washington-based)*: Manages marketing strategy, business partnerships, and growth initiatives, including identifying new market opportunities and overseeing promotional campaigns.
        ▪︎ *Developers*: Responsible for coding, implementing game features, and troubleshooting issues.
        ▪︎ *Designers*: Create game assets and work on UI/UX to enhance user engagement.
        ▪︎ *QA Testers*: Perform testing to ensure the game’s functionality and quality.
    ◦ *Administrative Staff*: Handle business operations, customer support, and finance.
    ◦ *Location of work*: Most work is performed remotely, with occasional in-person meetings or collaborations.
4. *Employee Start Date in Washington*:
5.  Our Washington-based employee began work on September 4, 2024.
